channel.title: North Wales Pioneer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: Wetherspoons to axe 12 items from all pub menus in just days - see the full list
item.description: JD Wetherspoon's 2025 festive menu is coming to an end on December 31, meaning the 12 items that are part of it will be removed from all pub menus.

item.title: Bins left unemptied and streets strewn with dog waste bags in Llandudno
item.description: Bins across Llandudno were left unemptied over Christmas week, leaving streets strewn with rubbish and dog waste bags, causing “a health hazard”.

item.title: 'Most deprived' areas across Llandudno to be discussed to benefit from £20m
item.description: The authority is one of nine areas to receive up to £20m over 10 years under the scheme.

item.title: 24-hours to learn! Young actress steps in as Belle at Theatre Colwyn panto
item.description: The pantomime, hosted by Magic Light Productions, is running at the theatre until January 3, 2026.

item.title: Colwyn Bay nursery’s heartfelt fundraiser raises more than £1,200 for Alder Hey
item.description: Kids Planet Ashbourne House, in Colwyn Bay, held a sponsored week. The fundraiser was inspired by personal experiences shared by staff.

item.title: Launch date for new crime series filmed in North Wales - watch the trailer
item.description: Eagle-eye residents also spied filming taking place at Aberffraw; Aberffraw is featured in the trailer for the show.

item.title: How to watch Jools Holland's 2025 Annual Hootenanny (and the celebrities joining him)
item.description: Jools Holland will welcome in the New Year with the likes of Olivia Dean, Jessie J, Craig David, Ronnie Wood and Lulu - how to watch and the full lineup.

item.title: King’s Police Medal for North Wales Police inspector recognises outstanding service
item.description: A TEMPORARY Inspector at North Wales Police has been recognised in the New Years Honours.

item.title: McDonald's 'best burger ever' set to make permanent return in 2026 - find out when
item.description: McDonald's has announced that the Big Arch burger will return to restaurants in the UK and Ireland in 2026, where it will become a permanent menu item.

item.title: Why do people eat 12 grapes on New Year's Eve? Tradition and meaning explained
item.description: There is a Spanish tradition to eat 12 grapes under the table on New Year's Eve, but why is this done, and what does it mean?
